title: Didn't work for me ...
text:
Didn't work for me .... I've had neck problems for several years, and had ACDF surgery to deal with 2 herniated disks and severe bone spurs about five years ago, so I'm always looking for things that will help me get through the night without waking up in pain multiple times.

I had such high hopes for this pillow, but to be honest, it didn't work at all. In fact, it seemed to exacerbate the problem. Clearly, it works for some folks, so I suspect it's a size/shape issue -- it just doesn't work with all necks.

product_metadata.title: Sagin o Cervical Memory Foam Pillow for Sleeping, Orthopedic Neck Pillow with Contouring Comfort, Cradles Neck & Shoulder for Side/Back/Stomach Sleeper with 2 Washable Pillowcases
features: 【Relieve Neck and Shoulder Pain】This cervical pillow helps maintain the correct sleeping posture. Pressures across your head and shoulders can be distributed evenly to relieve soreness in your neck and spine. Wake up feeling refreshed and energized to start the day.

【2 Pillowcases Included】The pillow come with a white pillowcase already on, along with a separately packaged gray pillowcase. Both pillowcases can be machine washed, ensuring you will always have a clean pillowcase for replacing.

【Ideal Pillow for Side Sleeper and Back Stomach Sleeper】The ergonomic design of the pillow helps to relieve cervical stress and resultant discomfort. The high and low profile on both sides adapts to the natural curvature of human body. Extra armrests of ergonomic pillows support your arms.

【Breathable and Skin-friendly】The pillow core is made of 100% memory foam, which is soft and comfortable. The pillowcase is made of 38% bamboo fiber and 62% polyester fiber, which are breathable and skin-friendly.

【Ventilation is Required】 The pillow may have a natural memory foam odor, which is normal and harmless to human body. You may put the pillow near window for 3-5 days before use, keep it cool and dry, avoid sunlight. (If you receive a scented pillow and it cannot dissipate for more than a week, please contact us immediately, we will be responsible for it)

【Packaging Upgrade】We have newly upgraded the packaging. The classic packaging and the new packaging will be shipped randomly during the transition period, but please rest assured that the quality of the products in the packaging is the same.
